You may not share API tokens to exceed GitHub's rate limitations.
You use credits when you chat with Copilot and work with agents. Code completions and next edit suggestions don't use credits. They remain unlimited with every paid plan.

clauses.section: What is included in GitHub Copilot Free?
clauses.quote: GitHub Copilot Free users are limited to 2,000 completions and access to entry level models per month.

clauses.section: What happens when I hit my usage limit?
clauses.quote: On GitHub Copilot Business and GitHub Copilot Enterprise, admins set usage limits and decide whether additional paid usage is allowed. If it isn't, Copilot pauses until the next cycle.

Abuse or excessively frequent requests to GitHub via the API may result in the temporary or permanent suspension of your Account's access to the API. GitHub, in our sole discretion, will determine abuse or excessive usage of the API.
